watches.name: Mecha Quartz Silver, Silk Black
watches.description: A watch you’ll look at twice. The design language comes from our very first watch – the Akerfalk First Season. Clean lines, a simple dial and that understated Scandinavian look that has been with us from the beginning. This time, we’ve taken that familiar design and given it a more traditional 12-hour layout. Against the silk black dial, the yellow seconds hand adds just enough contrast – its colour inspired by the yellow of the Swedish flag. A small detail, and a subtle nod to where we come from. Then you notice the way it moves. Instead of the familiar quartz tick, the seconds hand moves smoothly across the dial, giving the watch the character and feeling we normally associate with a mechanical timepiece. Inside is a Japanese Mecha Quartz movement. You get the charm of that sweeping movement, combined with the simplicity and reliability of quartz. No winding. No fuss. Just put it on and go. It’s a watch designed for every day. Simple enough to go with almost anything, but with just enough character to make you look at it one more time. And maybe make someone else ask about it too. Familiar by design. Different in motion. All watches are shipped from Sweden. Case size: 40mm Thickness: 10,3mm Dial color: Silk black Case color: Silver, stainless steel Watch strap: Quick release Black Horween leather Glass: K1 mineral Movement: Seiko VH-31 Mecha Quartz Movement Lug size: 20mm Water resistant: 5ATM Guarantee: 24 months Developed and tested in Sweden

watches.description: Inspired by the timeless style you've come to know from us, the Akerfalk Aventyr is more than just a watch, it’s a reflection of your adventurous spirit. Powered by a precise 24-hour Ronda movement, this timepiece is built to accompany you wherever your adventure takes you, whether you're diving into the deep or attending a formal event. With its premium dull steel in vanta black, the Akerfalk Aventyr offers both durability and style. The quick-release system makes it easy to switch straps, allowing you to customize your look effortlessly. No matter the occasion, this watch adapts to your lifestyle, combining retro charm with the unique 24-hour dial. Developed, designed, and shipped directly from Sweden, the Akerfalk Aventyr brings a touch of Swedish craftsmanship to your wrist. It's not just about telling time, it's about making a statement with a watch that's ready for anything.
